name: Standing Order Identification 8
definition: Defines the elements used to uniquely identify a standing order.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification for a standing order, as assigned by the account servicer or the account owner.

Account.name: Account
Account.definition: Business relationship between two entities; one entity is the account owner, the other entity is the account servicer.

AccountOwner.name: Account Owner
AccountOwner.definition: Party that legally owns the account.
